name: Laws of Bangladesh: the laws in force that the official site publishes in English
label: Bangladesh

not_included.note: laws in force that the site has only in Bengali; whether to add them is not decided

record_note: The Laws of Bangladesh site (bdlaws.minlaw.gov.bd) publishes only the current text of each law, so each law has one version here: the text as retrieved on 2026-10-28. There is no line-by-line history before that day. The amendment footnotes are kept in the files and parsed into data/amendments.csv. Only the laws the site has in English are included; the 760 laws in force that it has only in Bengali are listed in data/bengali-only.csv.

dates.commit: the day the pages were retrieved
dates.before_1970: not used: every commit is dated 2026-10-28

author.consolidated: Laws of Bangladesh (Legislative and Parliamentary Affairs Division)
author.unexplained: Laws of Bangladesh (Legislative and Parliamentary Affairs Division)

scope.when_absent: not extracted for Bangladesh; savings and transitional rules are in the amending laws

default_reach.meaning: a repeal does not affect anything done, rights acquired or proceedings pending under the repealed law unless a different intention appears
default_reach.authority: General Clauses Act, 1897 (Act No. X of 1897), section 6 (effect of repeal)
